params.message:
Take Gentells Standard 0.19.0 and read the region tree at any depth

The tagging gate holds every post and trend whose tags the pinned Standard
does not know. The pipeline is about to tag Belgium, the Netherlands and
Luxembourg (Standard 0.19.0), and the site was on 0.17.0: each of those
would have come off the site. The pinned copy moves to v0.19.0.

The countries hang under Benelux, not directly under Europe, so the region
tree is read at any depth: a Belgian card says Belgium, Belgium with the
Netherlands says Benelux. The cold-start snapshot is regenerated.

Portal: gentells.com kent België, Nederland en Luxemburg als regio, zodat trends met die tags zichtbaar blijven.
